scope: Source-audited review of 20 published European landscape identities; 10 attributable financing and grant events for 6 companies approved pending rollback rehearsal.

sources.title: MGI Engineering confirms OxLEP Go-Create ERDF funding for its cargo eVTOL programme

rounds.note_en: MGI confirms that it secured the OxLEP Go-Create programme as part of the European Regional Development Fund. The award amount and original award date are not published, so the company announcement date and an undisclosed amount are preserved.
rounds.coverage_note_en: MGI confirms two distinct public funding programmes for its cargo eVTOL work; both are recorded with undisclosed award amounts and announcement-date precision.

sources.title: MGI Engineering confirms Getting Building Fund support secured through OxLEP

rounds.note_en: MGI confirms a separate Government Getting Building Fund award secured through OxLEP Business. The award amount and original award date are not disclosed.
rounds.coverage_note_en: MGI confirms two distinct public funding programmes for its cargo eVTOL work; both are recorded with undisclosed award amounts and announcement-date precision.

sources.title: Gungnir Capital confirms its lead investment in Monava alongside Foundry Ventures and Hede Capital
Fylgia confirms completion of Monava financing and the three-investor syndicate

rounds.note_en: Gungnir and transaction counsel confirm the completed pre-seed syndicate. No source discloses the round size or individual contributions.
rounds.coverage_note_en: The 2026 pre-seed led by Gungnir Capital is recorded with undisclosed amount and explicitly supported participant roles.

sources.title: ILTE confirms a signed EUR1.12m loan agreement with Monopulse operator MNP Technologijos

rounds.note_en: ILTE states that MNP Technologijos, operating under the Monopulse brand, signed the EUR1.12m loan under the 'Billion for Business' programme. The debt is kept separate from later equity financing.
rounds.coverage_note_en: The signed 2025 ILTE loan and more-than-EUR2m 2026 equity round are recorded separately; earlier programme-support claims remain unreconciled.

sources.title: Coinvest Capital confirms Monopulse's more-than-EUR2m round and investor syndicate

rounds.note_en: Coinvest Capital reports a round exceeding EUR2m. NGL Ventures and 68 individual angels contributed EUR560,000 in aggregate; the individuals are not invented as named participants. Other cheque sizes are undisclosed.
rounds.coverage_note_en: The signed 2025 ILTE loan and more-than-EUR2m 2026 equity round are recorded separately; earlier programme-support claims remain unreconciled.

sources.title: UKRI Gateway to Research lists GBP73,815 for Motion Robotics' SEASHORE project

rounds.note_en: The official UKRI organisation record attributes GBP73,815 to Motion Robotics for the August 2022 to August 2023 SEASHORE project. Other organisations' awards on the same page are not assigned to Motion Robotics.
rounds.coverage_note_en: The beneficiary-specific GBP73,815 SEASHORE grant is recorded; a separate government robotics-project reference lacks an award-level company amount.

sources.title: Polish European Funds bulletin reports nearly PLN7.5m for MSP InnTech's AutoLand project

rounds.note_en: The official bulletin states that MSP InnTech received nearly PLN7.5m from the Smart Growth programme for the AutoLand project. The rounded amount is preserved as approximate.
rounds.coverage_note_en: Two company-specific EU contributions are recorded; the later PLN70.7m SPEEDJET consortium budget is not assigned without a beneficiary split.

sources.title: Open Innovation Network beneficiary list records PLN446,850 for MSP InnTech
MSP InnTech project page confirms PLN446,850 European Funds contribution

rounds.note_en: The company and programme beneficiary list agree on the PLN446,850 contribution toward a PLN1,221,390 technology-acquisition project. Only the external contribution is recorded.
rounds.coverage_note_en: Two company-specific EU contributions are recorded; the later PLN70.7m SPEEDJET consortium budget is not assigned without a beneficiary split.

sources.title: Angel One confirms its USD150,000 investment in NORDA Dynamics

rounds.note_en: Angel One confirms the USD150,000 syndication investment. No unsupported lead designation or individual cheque split is inferred.
rounds.coverage_note_en: Angel One's USD150k investment and the later USD1m Varangians-led round are recorded separately; a secondary USD5k competition-grant claim remains unreconciled.

sources.title: MITS Capital confirms NORDA Dynamics' USD1m round led by Varangians
